label: Copy phase: L=3 sequences (esp. final output) or re-input of h/i
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (t > L), never on original-phase or <DEL> steps, and never on the first copy step (recall_idx 0). There are two components that do not relate to each other. (1) L=3 sequences: 21% of their steps are active, and the final step (t=5) is active 87% of the time and holds 31% of the mass. It is weaker at the first copy-phase step, t=4. Some L=4 steps at t=6 (recall_idx 2) fire too. The top activations are all L=3 at t=5, regardless of token. (2) In longer sequences it fires diffusely when the fed-back input is h or i (lift about 9x / 8x), with an extra time-dependent bump at t=11-12 and at L=9 t=17. This component has low precision: most copy-phase h/i inputs do not fire. Coverage rises with activation quartile (93% of the top quartile vs 62% of the bottom), but precision is poor overall (~0.24), so this is a loose description. L=5 almost never fires.
